The open-source DSH companion plugin for **DeepPilot**, a native iPhone client
for using DeepSeek Harness remotely. It connects the app directly to the DSH
Host on your own computer and does not replace or modify the DSH Web UI.

This source checkout targets Node.js 22+ and DSH hosts inside the rolling
compatibility range `>=0.2.1-rc.5 <0.3.0-0` with a `web` profile. The lower
bound is the newest audited `rc` release at decision time — npm `latest` and
`next` both point at `0.2.1-rc.5` — and every later `0.2.x` release is admitted
automatically, including the `alpha` channel release `0.2.2-alpha.2` and later
alphas, later rc releases, and `0.2.x` GA. `0.3.0` and its prereleases stay
refused until a fresh audit. DSH checks a plugin's declared requirements before
composing a profile, on every start rather than only on install, so a host
outside the range refuses to activate this plugin. From DSH `0.2.1-alpha.4` on,
that check reads `engines.dsh` and ignores `peerDependencies`; older hosts know
only the peer range, so both declare the identical range. The package includes
Funnel helpers for macOS, Linux, and Windows on amd64/arm64; trusted-LAN mode
does not require the helper. The helper is built with Go 1.27, which requires
**macOS 13 Ventura or later**: on macOS 12 and earlier, Funnel mode cannot
start, while trusted-LAN mode keeps working.

The current working tree declares that range in `engines.dsh` and
`peerDependencies` and is built/typechecked against `0.2.1-rc.5`. A previously
published plugin package may still carry its own older compatibility
declaration until a release is made from this tree.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-deeppilot
dsh web
```

After DSH restarts, open **Settings → DeepPilot**, turn on **Allow phone connections**,
and click **Add phone** beside **Paired devices**, then scan the QR code in the app. The same panel also shows one copyable piece of pairing info (address, single-use code and
certificate fingerprint) that can be pasted into the app in one step — useful for
Simulator or when the camera is unavailable. Switching between the LAN and
public address issues a matching new QR code and string immediately, with the
panel staying open.

LAN access is always on (there is no switch) on the plugin's independent TCP
port `3098` and is TLS-only. After every connection the plugin tells the app
its current LAN addresses and the public Funnel address, so a paired phone
connects over the LAN on the same Wi-Fi and falls back to Funnel elsewhere,
without pairing again. The plugin generates a self-signed certificate on first start
(key under `$DSH_HOME/deeppilot/lan-tls/`), and the pairing QR code carries its
public-key fingerprint so the app pins that exact Host. DSH may continue
listening only on `127.0.0.1:3080`; the plugin no longer registers any `/phone`
routes on the DSH web server. If a firewall is enabled, allow inbound TCP
`3098` on the networks you use. The port can be changed on the DeepPilot
settings page (its exact section may move between DSH versions; go by the
settings page's current layout).

Upgrading from a plugin version that served plain `ws://` on the LAN: devices
paired over the LAN must pair again so they receive the certificate
fingerprint. Devices paired through Funnel are unaffected.

Package: [npmjs.com/package/dsh-deeppilot](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-deeppilot)

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-deeppilot
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-deeppilot
```

Restart DSH after updating. Uninstalling the package does not delete the local
DeepPilot state under `$DSH_HOME/deeppilot/`.

Conversation traffic travels directly between the iPhone and your DSH Host and
is always encrypted: the LAN listener on port `3098` serves TLS with a
self-signed certificate whose fingerprint the app receives during pairing, and
Funnel mode uses Tailscale-issued certificates. The app refuses plain `ws://`.
Both the LAN listener and optional Funnel mode expose only the DeepPilot
connection, one-time pairing, and health endpoints, not the complete DSH Web UI.

The DeepPilot settings page exposes **Connections per public source**. It
defaults to `8`, accepts `1`–`16`, and briefly restarts the Funnel helper when
changed, so connected remote clients reconnect once (its exact section may
move between DSH versions; go by the settings page's current layout). The
device list also supports a custom name for each paired device. Names are
stored in the host registry and survive iPhone reconnects or changes to the
system-reported name; saving an empty value restores the iPhone-reported
default.

Each device's **More actions** control contains its fingerprint, rename action,
and deletion action; deletion still requires confirmation. Connection options,
connection help, diagnostic tools, and system information start collapsed.
Desktop secondary buttons are 28px high; custom action touch targets remain at
least 44px. **Add phone** uses DSH's built-in small outlined `Button`; all
toggles use its `Switch`. Native controls keep the host's appearance and sizing.
See [settings UI and validation](docs/SETTINGS_UI.md).

The settings page's **Diagnostic tools** group has a `debug` toggle.
Turning it on prints per-frame and push diagnostics to the DSH host's terminal
output (for example, the actual capability bits sent in `s2c.welcome`); it
never prints pairing tokens, APNs tokens, or message content. The toggle is
snapshotted per connection, so an already-open connection only picks up the new
value after it reconnects.

**Connection failures do not need that toggle.** The plugin always records
admission rejections, authentication failures (4401 distinguishes an unknown
device, a revoked device, a bad signature, an expired challenge and clock skew),
TLS handshake failures and pairing failures. They show up in the terminal as
`[deeppilot] <time> WARN <event> <reason> src=<source hash> attempt=<attempt ID>`
and are appended under `diagnostics/` in the plugin data directory (7 days,
5 MB cap). The settings page's **Connection diagnostics** group lists the most
recent failures with a copy button, and `/phone/health` additionally returns the
local transport phase and port, the data-plane phase, whether the TLS identity
was rebuilt, the start time and the last failure, so the phone can locate the
cause even while it cannot connect. Records contain only source hashes — never
raw IPs, pairing codes, keys, APNs tokens or message content.

Each connection attempt from the phone carries a random `attemptId` (the `?at=`
query parameter on the WebSocket upgrade, or the `X-DeepPilot-Attempt` header on
pairing and health checks). The plugin writes it into the log lines and
diagnostic events above, so a user reporting that ID lets you find the exact
attempt in the host log.

Offline push is optional. Relay mode sends only the target APNs device token
and a limited notification payload; full conversation history and live output
do not pass through the relay. Read [PRIVACY.md](./PRIVACY.md) and
[SECURITY.md](./SECURITY.md) before enabling remote access or push. Protocol-v2
implementation status and remaining release validation are tracked in
[docs/SECURITY_ROADMAP.md](./docs/SECURITY_ROADMAP.md).

See [COMPATIBILITY.md](./COMPATIBILITY.md) for the tested baseline and current
limitations. DSH is still evolving; include exact DSH and plugin versions when

[PROTOCOL.md](./PROTOCOL.md) is the normative DeepPilot bridge protocol. Any
wire change must update that document and `src/protocol.ts` together and be
coordinated with the private iOS client. Protocol v2 is the only supported wire
version; upgrades from v1 require re-pairing.

当前源码面向 Node.js 22+ 与**滚动兼容区间** `>=0.2.1-rc.5 <0.3.0-0` 内的
DSH 宿主（带 `web` profile）。下界是决策时最新的已审计 `rc` 版本（npm
`latest` 与 `next` 均指向 `0.2.1-rc.5`）；其后的所有 `0.2.x` 版本自动放行，
包括 `alpha` 通道的 `0.2.2-alpha.2` 及之后的 alpha、之后的 rc 与 `0.2.x`
正式版。`0.3.0` 及其预发布仍需重新审计，由上界 `<0.3.0-0` 拦下。
DSH 在组合 profile 前会校验插件声明的兼容要求，且**每次启动都会校验**（不只是
安装时），因此区间外的宿主会拒绝激活本插件。从 DSH `0.2.1-alpha.4` 起，该校验
只读 `engines.dsh` 并忽略 `peerDependencies`；更早的宿主只认 peer 范围，因此
两处声明同一区间。npm 包内置 macOS、Linux、Windows 的 amd64/arm64 Funnel
helper；可信局域网模式不依赖 helper。helper 用 Go 1.27 编译，要求 **macOS 13
Ventura 或更高版本**：macOS 12 及更早版本无法启动 Funnel 模式，可信局域网模式
不受影响。

当前工作树的 `engines.dsh` 与 `peerDependencies` 声明该区间，构建与类型检查
针对 `0.2.1-rc.5`。从此工作树发布新版本前，已发布的旧插件包仍可能带有各自旧的
兼容声明。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-deeppilot
dsh web
```

DSH 重启后，打开 **设置 → DeepPilot**，开启“允许手机连接”，在“已配对设备”右侧
点击“添加手机”，然后在 DeepPilot App 中扫码。配对面板中还显示一段可复制的「配对信息」（含地址、一次性配对码
与证书指纹），在 App 里粘贴一次即可完成配对，适合模拟器或相机不可用时使用；在「内网 /
公网」之间切换会立即为所选地址生成新的二维码与配对信息，面板保持展开。

局域网连接始终开启（没有开关），使用插件独立的 TCP `3098` 端口，且只提供 TLS。每次连上后，
插件会把当前的局域网地址和公网 Funnel 地址告诉 App：同一 Wi-Fi 下手机自动走局域网，在外自动
改走 Funnel，不需要重新配对。插件首次启动时生成
自签证书（私钥位于 `$DSH_HOME/deeppilot/lan-tls/`），配对二维码携带其公钥指纹，
App 只信任与该指纹一致的主机。DSH 可以继续只监听 `127.0.0.1:3080`；插件不再在
DSH Web 服务上注册任何 `/phone` 路由。启用系统防火墙时，请仅在你使用的网络放行
入站 TCP `3098`；端口可在 DeepPilot 设置页里修改（具体分区随 DSH 版本可能调整，
以设置页实际布局为准）。

从仍在局域网提供明文 `ws://` 的旧版本插件升级：通过局域网配对的设备需要重新扫码
配对，以接收证书指纹；经 Funnel 配对的设备不受影响。

完整会话流量由 iPhone 直接连接用户自己的 DSH Host，且始终加密：独立 `3098`
端口的局域网监听器使用自签证书提供 TLS，指纹在配对时下发给 App；Funnel 模式
使用 Tailscale 签发的证书。App 拒绝明文 `ws://`。局域网监听器和可选 Funnel
模式都只暴露经过认证的 DeepPilot 连接、单次配对与健康检查端点，不会暴露完整
DSH Web UI。

DeepPilot 设置页提供“每个公网来源的连接上限”，默认 `8`，可设置为 `1`–`16`
（具体分区随 DSH 版本可能调整，以设置页实际布局为准）。修改后 Funnel helper
会短暂重启，已连接的远程客户端会自动重连一次。设备列表支持为每台已配对设备设置
自定义名称；名称会保存在主机设备注册表中，即使 iPhone 重连或上报了新的系统名称
也不会被覆盖。留空保存可恢复 iPhone 上报的默认名称。

设备行的“更多操作”可查看指纹、重命名或删除设备；删除仍需再次确认。
连接选项、连接帮助、诊断工具和系统信息默认收起。桌面次要操作按钮高 28px，
自有操作的触屏点击区域至少 44px。“添加手机”直接使用 DSH 内置 `Button` 的小号描边样式，所有开关使用内置 `Switch`；这些原生控件的外观与尺寸均沿用宿主。布局与验收方式见 [设置页说明](docs/SETTINGS_UI.md)。

设置页的“诊断工具”分组下有一个 `debug` 开关，打开后会在 DSH host 的
终端输出里打印逐帧与推送等诊断信息（例如 `s2c.welcome` 里实际发出的能力位），
不会打印配对令牌、APNs token 或消息内容。该开关按连接快照，已建立的连接需要
重连一次才按新值工作。

**连不上时不需要打开这个开关**：插件会无条件记录准入拒绝、认证失败（4401 会区分
设备不存在、已撤销、签名错、挑战过期、时钟偏差等原因）、TLS 握手失败与配对失败，
在终端输出为 `[deeppilot] <时间> WARN <事件> <原因> src=<来源哈希> attempt=<尝试 ID>`，
并落盘到插件数据目录的 `diagnostics/`（保留 7 天、上限 5 MB）。设置页“连接诊断”
分组可查看最近失败并一键复制；`/phone/health` 额外返回本地传输相位与端口、数据面
相位、是否重建过 TLS 身份、启动时间与最近一次失败，手机端在连不上时也能据此定位。
记录只含来源哈希，不含原始 IP、配对码、密钥、APNs token 或消息内容。

手机端每次连接尝试会带一个随机的 `attemptId`（WebSocket 升级的 `?at=` 查询参数，
或配对/健康检查的 `X-DeepPilot-Attempt` 请求头）。插件把它写进上面的日志与诊断
事件；用户反馈时报告这个 ID，就能在主机日志里定位到同一次尝试。

离线推送是可选功能。中继模式只发送目标 APNs 设备 Token 和有限的通知内容；
完整会话历史与实时输出不会经过中继。启用远程访问或推送前，请阅读
[PRIVACY.md](./PRIVACY.md) 与 [SECURITY.md](./SECURITY.md)。协议 v2 的实现状态与
剩余发布验证记录在 [docs/SECURITY_ROADMAP.zh-CN.md](./docs/SECURITY_ROADMAP.zh-CN.md)。
